question_text: This text describes how an airport solved the problem of annoyed passengers.
answer_explanation: This text describes how an airport solved the problem of annoyed passengers.
context_text: Tekst B: WALK MORE, WAIT LESS Some years ago, Houston airport received a large number of complaints from passengers who had to wait for their suitcases in the arrivals terminal. The airport administration made a careful analysis. They found that passengers spent just one minute walking from the arrival gate to the baggage pick-up area, and then seven minutes on average waiting for their bags. The airport administration moved the arrival gate further away, so passengers now have to walk six minutes instead of one, before they can pick up their luggage. Complaints have dropped to nearly zero since then. It seems that people prefer walking to just standing and waiting.

correct_answer: Hi Mark, Guess what! Last week I won a photo competition for teenagers. I decided to take part in the competition because I love taking photos and I wanted to show my talent to a wider audience. In the photo you can see my parents with my brother and our dog. The ceremony started with a concert and then the winners got their prizes and congratulations. You should also take part in the photo competition the following year. It’s really worth doing it. Maybe someday we’ll go on a trip together and I’ll show you how to take good photos.

Należy uznać każdą komunikatywną odpowiedź, w której zdający relacjonuje przebieg wręczania nagród.
